catalog.scope: Native PIO/DMA GP2 on Pico A and B; historical 132/138/150 MHz engineering results keep their actual source/image identities. The selected Phase 14 artifact is C96/138 MHz; no current installed-image assertion is made. P15.13 adds only Pico A / 138 MHz / current source 165303458e49 at 40.001 and 60.001 MHz; this does not qualify broad frequency intervals or Pico B on current firmware.

status_definitions.Qualified: Met the applicable conducted carrier, decode or human-copy requirements within the recorded board, clock, source/image and setup scope.
status_definitions.Unqualified: Did not meet the applicable qualification requirement; includes the operator-required all-mode reliable-WSPR gate at 4m.
status_definitions.Unavailable: The native engine cannot construct the requested output; experimental frequency consent does not override engine limits.
status_definitions.Untested: Outside the agreed matrix, with no qualification result.

catalog.mode_application: Each qualification_by_band status applies to all five modes at its recorded points and source/image scope. New 8m/5m entries use only the exact P15.13 point/board/clock and receiver conditions below; no broad-interval promotion follows.

notes.6m_WSPR: Qualified includes separately reviewed Pico A/138 MHz receiver-only +125 Hz retune acceptance; the transmitted waveform and original nominal failed flags remain unchanged.
notes.4m: Unqualified at representable 150 MHz under the all-mode reliable-WSPR requirement. Unavailable for direct synthesis at 132/138 MHz. Successful individual Tone, keyed and occasional WSPR observations remain unchanged; the all-mode status does not claim each mode failed individually.
notes.2m: Unavailable for native direct output at all three clocks; no native harmonic mapping is implemented. Manually mapped 138 MHz third-harmonic WSPR pilots remain Unqualified evidence, without promoting the other modes to tested failures.
notes.8m_5m: P15.13 qualified all five modes only at 40.001/60.001 MHz on Pico A, current clean-source 165303458e49, normal 138 MHz. WSPR requires demonstrated fixed receiver-audio translation (+125/+200 Hz respectively); accepted 5m WSPR uses a cold boot and waveform-equivalent compact realized-frequency complete jobs. Broad envelopes retain the experimental opt-in. Nominal failures, invalid/partial attempts and four diagnostic RF windows are preserved in the result matrix. Pico B and alternate clocks were not tested.
notes.limits: Unfiltered conducted evidence does not establish calibrated transmitter power or antenna-ready emissions.

catalog.historical_record: All other top-level fields retain the October 11 operator-amended release-scope record, including its original UNSUPPORTED_RELEASE labels, dates, evidence and then-pending gates. Current catalog status is qualification_by_band; historical fields are not a current completion or availability assertion.

p15_13.five_metre_wspr_condition: Known inactive reboot, compact complete job with exact realized frequencies and merged equal-frequency events; same sampled waveform and ordinary current firmware.
p15_13.admission: allow_unqualified_frequency=true; allow_non_amateur_frequency=false. Broad correlation envelopes are not promoted.

operator_instruction: If WSPR cannot decode it, 2m and 4m, so long as there were no faults that prevented synthesis, cross them off as not supported for all modes
criterion: Required reliable external expected-message WSPR decoding was not achieved despite complete synthesized transmissions and valid control/resource/capture evidence; exclude each entire band from Phase 14 release support.
four_metre_note: The 150 MHz image synthesizes four distinct states and some retained frames decode. Failed required repetitions and later diagnostics remain negative; occasional successes do not restore support under the operator's all-mode exclusion.
two_metre_note: Direct synthesis is outside all three clocks' range. Third-harmonic pilots produced four distinct RF states but neither expected WSPR message decoded. No native harmonic mapping is claimed.
continuation: Preserve existing positive/negative evidence. Replace the former mandatory positive 4m prerequisite with independently bound operator exclusion in a separately reviewed follow-on admission; do not execute the old mixed/memory entry as-is. Internal reserve and all remaining release gates still apply.
